According to Lyft’s 2022 Form 10-K, long-term debt, net of the current portion, was approximately **$1.73 billion** at December 31, 2022. Lyft’s 2022 revenue was approximately **$4.10 billion**, so long-term debt represented:

\[
\frac{1.73\text{ billion}}{4.095\text{ billion}}\times 100 \approx \mathbf{42.3\%}
\]

Thus, Lyft’s long-term debt was approximately **42.3% of its 2022 revenue**. **[1]**

**Calculation:** $803.207 million ÷ $4,095.135 million × 100 = **19.61%**
